text: ＊の　＊が　ぐーんと　あがった！

patterns.name: 〜と (sound word)
patterns.span: ぐーんと　あがった
patterns.explanation: と after a sound-effect word ties it to the action and tells you in what way the action happens. ぐーんと　あがった = 'rose with a big surge'.

patterns.name: 〜た
patterns.explanation: た on the end of a verb says the thing has already happened. あがった = 'rose'.
